name: Zechariah (son of Jehoshaphat)
title: Jewish king's son killed by his brother
summary: Zechariah was one of King Jehoshaphat's sons. When his brother Joram took the throne, Joram killed all his brothers with the sword to secure his own power.

keyEvents.title: Killed by his brother Joram
keyEvents.description: Joram killed all his brothers, including Zechariah, after he took the kingdom from Jehoshaphat.
